test: none: open on SolidCraft's truck kernel (kernel work paused under tangency-labs/solidcraft#3992); geometry is the issue's
summary: On SolidCraft's truck kernel a slab cut whose planar face stands 8.8e-5 mm from a bore (closer than the 1e-4 tolerance) came out 0.708 mm^3 short (#4095). A 90 x 60 x 20 block with an r 15 bore through it; the 6 x 16 x 14 slab's face x = -15.000088 stands just outside the bore. The slab removes exactly its 6 x 16 x 8 inside the block. A control puts the face at -15.00022, outside the tolerance.

cases.name: face_inside_tolerance
cases.note: Slab from x = -21.000088: its face at x = -15.000088, 8.8e-5 from the bore.

volume.formula: 90*60*20 - pi*15^2*20 - 6*16*8 (the slab stays clear of the bore and removes its whole 6 x 16 x 8 inside the block)

cases.name: face_outside_tolerance_control
cases.note: Control: slab from x = -21.00022, its face 2.2e-4 from the bore.

volume.formula: 90*60*20 - pi*15^2*20 - 6*16*8 (the slab stays clear of the bore and removes its whole 6 x 16 x 8 inside the block)
